rows.note: Use this casual construction when you name what the harmful thing is bad for, such as health or the environment.

example.english: Staying up late all the time is detrimental to your health.
example.jyutping: seng4 jat6 ngaai4 je6 deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose adjective for something that causes actual harm or damage.

example.english: This cleaning product is detrimental to your skin, so remember to wear gloves.
example.traditional: 呢種清潔劑對皮膚有害，記住戴手套。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 cing1 git3 zai1 deoi3 pei4 fu1 jau5 hoi6 gei3 zyu6 daai3 sau2 tou3
